 Home Alert New Roundabouts on Route 997 Near Waynesboro Set to Open Wednesday New Roundabouts on Route 997 Near Waynesboro Set to Open Wednesday
 Sun, November 15, 2026 by Staff Report 
 SHARE NOW 
 Motorists traveling along Route 997 (Anthony Highway) near Waynesboro will soon see a major change in traffic patterns as the Pennsylvania Department of Transportation (PennDOT) prepares to open two new roundabouts in their final configuration on Wednesday, November 18.
 The roundabouts are located in Washington Township, Franklin County, at the intersections of Route 997 and Orchard Road and at the new connection between Route 997 and Washington Township Boulevard.
 According to PennDOT, crews will spend Monday, November 16, and Tuesday, November 17, completing pavement markings and painting traffic lines along Route 997, Orchard Road, and Washington Township Boulevard within the construction area.
 Weather permitting, the work will take place during daylight hours. Motorists should expect single-lane restrictions, with flaggers directing vehicles through the work zone.
 On Wednesday, November 18, the contractor plans to shift traffic into the final roundabout configurations. The change will also include opening the Orchard Road connection to the southern roundabout and the Washington Township Boulevard connection to the northern roundabout.
 PennDOT says temporary lane restrictions and flagging operations will be necessary while crews implement the new traffic patterns. Access to nearby businesses and residences will be maintained throughout the transition.
 The project is designed to improve traffic flow and roadway infrastructure along the busy Route 997 corridor near Waynesboro.
 In addition to constructing the two roundabouts, the project includes roadway widening, Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) compliant curb ramps, drainage improvements, stormwater management upgrades, and new roadway lighting.
 Motorists are encouraged to use caution when traveling through the construction area, remain alert for changing traffic patterns, and follow the directions of flaggers and posted traffic signs.
 The opening of the roundabouts marks a significant milestone in the Route 997 improvement project, although PennDOT has not announced a final completion date for all remaining work.
